title: New EBA RTS on Beneficial Ownership Registers (EBA/RTS/2024/03)
raw_content:
EBA Final draft RTS on access to beneficial ownership information (EBA/RTS/2024/03)

18 June 2024

These RTS specify procedures for credit institutions to access beneficial ownership registers. They apply from 1 January 2025.

Article 2: Member States shall provide a RESTful API using OAuth 2.0. Response times shall not exceed two seconds for 95 percent of queries.

Article 4: Obliged entities shall verify beneficial ownership at least once per year. Any discrepancy shall be escalated within five working days.
